gzung ba'am/ bklag pa'am/ kun chub par bya ba lta ci smos/ gzungs chen mo 'di'i ming tsam yang bskal pa bye ba phrag stong gi bar du thos par dka'o// kye ma gzungs chen mo 'di sems can gang dag gi lag na 'dug pa de dag ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa'o// 'tsho ba bzang pos 'tsho ba'o// mngon par shes pa rnams kyi gzhi bzang po'o// dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul la gnas pa'o// yon tan thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'o// 'di lan cig brjod pa tsam gyis ngan song gi sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// lan gnyis brjod pa tsam gyis sdig pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro// lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis nyon mongs pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro// de ltar na brjod pa tsam gyis gong nas gong du yon tan rnams 'thob par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang mthong bar 'gyur ro// 'chag bzhin du bzlas brjod byas na sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// shing gcig 'greng gi drung du bzlas brjod byas na grub pa thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ro// 'gro bzhin du bzlas brjod byas na sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro// nags tshal chen po'i nang du skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug la lan bdun brjod na bsam gtan chen po 'thob par gyur la nyon mongs pa dang yang bral bar 'gyur ro// 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sku gzugs kyi drung du skyil mo krung bcas te 'dug la me tog la sogs pa ji snyed pas mchod nas lus ngal bar gyur gyi bar du gzungs chen mo 'di brjod la/ ngal bar gyur nas de nyid du nyal na rmi lam du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po mthong bar 'gyur te/ phyag g.yas pas de la byugs nas yang dag par dbugs 'byin par mdzad de chos kyi snang ba chen po yang stsol bar mdzad do// 'di skad du rgyal ba'i sras legs so legs so// khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs pa yin te/

khyed tshe brjes nas sa chen po thob par 'gyur ro zhes kyang gsung ngo*// de nas lus bde ba dang*/ sems bde ba dang*/ dga' ba chen po dang*/ dwang ba dang*/ mchog tu dga' ba chen po dang ldan bzhin du sad par 'gyur ro// mthu che ba dang*/ dbang che bar grags par 'gyur ro// lha rnams kyang de la blta ba'i phyir 'ong ngo*// nangs par langs nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yang dag par bsdus pa'i mdo sde rnams kyis yang dag par bsdus pa'i mdo sde rnams bklag par bya'o// sems can thams cad la yang phan pa dang bde ba'i sems bskyed par bya'o// de nas pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing sdig pa thams cad dang bral te/ nyon mongs pa'i phyogs rnams bcom la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang bsngags par 'gyur ro// lha la sogs pa yang de la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i phyir brtson par 'gyur ro// de ltar ji skad bstan pa bzhin du byed pa'i rgyal ba'i sras de ni ring por mi thogs par kun tu bzang po'i sa chen po la 'jug par 'gyur ro// de nas rdo rje gtsug phud la sogs pa stong gsum gyi bdag po rig sngags 'chang ba chen po rnams dang*/ spyan chen mo la sogs pa rig sngags 'chang chen mo rnams dang*/ rdo rje snying po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ rdo rje zhags pa la sogs pa rig sngags kyi lha chen po rnams dang*/ rin chen drwa ba can la sogs pa rig sngags kyi lha mo chen mo rnams dang*/ lha mo sgrol ma la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang*/ dar chen dang*/ gzugs bzang dang*/ shin tu blta na sdug pa la sogs pa gzhon nu rnams dang*/ gzhon nu ma rnams dang*/ bran rnams dang*/ bran mo rnams dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa log 'dren chen po rnams dang*/ lus mchog la sogs pa srin po'i dbang po rnams dang*/

ma mo la sogs pa srin mo rnams dang*/ dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa lha'i dbang phyug rnams dang*/ rdo rje me tog thod la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen por 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa thams cad langs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mchog 'phags pa kun tu bzang po la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa bla na med pa'i yon tan gyi snang ba zhes bya bas bstod pa/ kun tu bzang po kun gyi mchog /sna tshogs kun gyi 'byor pa che// dkyil 'khor chen po rdo rje mchog /sna tshogs gzugs can phyogs kyi bdag /rdo rje chen po dgyes pa che// gzi brjid chen po stobs po che// gnon dang rab gnon dpal gyi rab// khyab bdag rgyal ba'i blo gros rgyal// rdo rje chen po rab tu bzhad// bsgrub dka' chen po sgrub mdzad pa// rol mo chen pos rnam par rol// rab dga' chen po 'dul ba po// lha chen dbang phyug chen po ste// btsan po khyab 'jug skye dgu'i bdag /sa steng sa 'og sa la dgyes// de bzhin sa 'dzin sa gsum pa// dul dang sbyin pa'i go rims thabs// rab mkhyen stong gi mnga' bdag lags// shes nyen can te bzod la dgyes// brtson 'grus 'byung ba 'byor pa che// brtson 'grus bcu dang thabs bcu pa// stobs bcu'i sras chen thu bo ste// mthu stobs stong gis spro ba dang*// yongs su ldan zhing bcu sel ba// rdul sel rgyal po chen po ste// rgyal po dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho pa// rdul rnams rab tu zhi ba'i thabs// cho ga mkhyen pa blo mnga' ba// mkhas pa mdzes pa skal ba bzang*// shin tu sdug pa dga' skyed pa// snying po chen po las byung ba// nyon mongs bral ba thub par dka'// sa dang mnyam pa mkha' dang mnyam// rlung dang mtshungs pa'i spyod yul can// gzi brjid nyid de gzi brjid mtshungs// rgya mtsho bzhi yi chu dang 'dra// rmugs dang smyo ba zhi bar mdzad// thub par dka' ba'i nyon mongs 'jil// g.yul sel g.yul la dgyes pa ste// g.yul gyi nyes pa rab 'joms pa// gsung bzang ngang pa'i gdangs su bzhad// dbang po nye dbang dbang chen sras// dbang po las lhag thub dang mnyam// chos 'dzin 'byor dang ldan par bstan// rab dga' bun long zhi mdzad pa// nyon mongs 'dam rdzab skem par mdzad// dbang po rgyags pa'i rims nad sel// khro bo'i dregs pa rnam par 'joms// gsung snyan 'jam pa nyid dang ldan// mnyam pa mi mnyam mnyam pa dang*// mnyam med yul las rnam par 'das// sangs rgyas kun dang spyod yul gcig

/byang chub snying por rgya cher rol// rim pa rab ston dge ba ste// spyan bzang phun sum tshogs pa dge// gtsang ma lam bzang sbyin mdzad pa// dag mdzad bsreg sbyin mchog sbyin po// 'joms byed bgegs rnams rnam par 'joms// 'thob mdzad dpe med gsung ba po// rdo rje'i 'jig rten gcig snang ba// skyes pa bud med tshogs kyi bdag /nges par yon tan 'byor mdzad pa// sems can 'khor ba zhi mdzad pa// brtan po sdig pa rnams dang bral// kun tu rnam rgyal snang ba po// kun tu rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor can// kun tu rgya mtsho'i snang ba mdzad// kun tu nyes pa sel ba lags// mi bzad sa 'og rnam par dkrugs// de bzhin zad mdzad thug par mdzad// nyon mongs rgya mtsho rnam par dkrugs// nyon mongs phyogs rnams zad par mdzad// 'bar ba'i dka' ba 'phro mdzad pa// rgyags shing bdo ba zhi bar mdzad// rdo rje chen po stobs skyed pa// sdang ba thams cad nges par 'joms// pha rol zhugs pa sdig sel ba// dag pa nam mkha'i spyod yul can// dge ba sbyin zhing yon tan sbyin// 'bras bu sbyin zhing kun sbyin pa// ye shes sbyin zhing bsod nams sbyin// longs spyod sbyin zhing rgyal sbyin pa// dbang phyug sbyin zhing tshig sbyin la// nor sbyin tshogs ldan rdo rje can// gzugs sbyin dpa' bo rnam par rgyal// dag cing dge ba'i tshul sbyin pa// bde 'byung gtsug na nor bu thogs// sa 'dzin gzung bar dka' ba po// dkyil 'khor mgu bar sgrub mdzad pa// 'bab cing de bzhin 'bebs par mdzad// rin chen drwa ba rin chen mnyam// sgron ma mun sel rgyal ba can// yon tan ye shes theg chen ldan// brtan mchog che ba'i chos nyid can// gsung ba chen po shes rab che// sangs rgyas tshul ni rab ston pa// mchod pa chen po theg chen gyi// theg pa bla na med par ldan// mchod pa chen po'i chos shes pa// 'bras bu chen po'i chos kyi mchog

/ston mdzad 'dul mdzad ston pa po// zhi ba de bzhin zhi mdzad pa// bzang po bzang dang mtshungs pa nyid// kun tu rab 'byams sel mdzad pa// snying rje ye shes snying po mkhyen// snying rje'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can// snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs// dus chen rnam par dag par mdzad// mtshon mchog dang ba rab mtho ba// rtsod chen 'das pa'i spyod yul can// skye dgu srung zhing spyan yangs pa// rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor can// kun tu spyod pa khong dge ba// dga' ba'i dam pa sbyin pa po// kun du yul kun mnga' ba ste// zhe sa bzang po rtag tu mnga'// dul ba sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// dkyil 'khor chen po'i pad+ma lags// zla ba lta bu'i sim mdzad thabs// mkhas pa rgyags spangs cho ga mkhyen// spyod yul gcig la gnas pa ste// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mnga'// dam tshig chen po de nyid mkhyen// slob dpon chen po grags pa che// dam pa nyid de bla na med// gsang sngags rlabs ni rgyas par mdzad// de ltar khyab bdag chen po ni// yon tan brgya yi spos kyis rgyas// dag cing byang la mkhas la sogs// yon tan 'byung la rig sngags rgyal// gtsug na nor bu thogs la sogs// mchog rnams kyis ni bstod nas kyang*// sdug bsngal chu bo bcom pa yi// bcom ldan 'das kyis tshig 'di gsungs// kye ma bstod pa chen po brgya// ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa yin// mi rnams la la gang zhig gis// sdig bsal kun tu bzang po la// snying nas 'di yis bstod byas na// des ni sangs rgyas zhing kyang 'thob// gang zhig ming brgya rtsa brgyad 'don// mi de yon tan yongs rdzogs shing*// de bzhin gshegs tshul che ba yi// ye shes ma lus smra bar nus// de ltar thub mchog sras po yon tan brgya yi spobs las nges par byung gyur cing*// yon tan sna tshogs 'byung dang 'jig rten yan chad dag gis yon tan rgyas rnams la// bstod pa chen po rnams byas rgyal ba'i sras la bstod pas nyin re bstod byas na// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i skur 'gyur snang ba thob cing rnam dag yon tan 'byung gnas 'gyur// 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs so// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi skor 'di rnams la sngags sogs 'dra min cung zad 'dug kyang*/

'di ni sa skyong sde dge'i spar ma'i bka' 'gyur rin po che si tu thams cad mkhyen pas ljags zhus mdzad pa las 'bru len gyis zhal bshus pa yin no// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
